name: Shanghai Awinic Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Awinic Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, and sale of integrated circuit chips in China and internationally. It offers audio, haptic, motor drivers, camera AF and OIS, power management, signal chain, RFFE, smart sensor ICs, ambient LED driver, and on-device AI; digital, audio amplifiers; voice chips, audio, automotive audio amplifiers; haptic feedback chips; OIS SoC chips and VCM motor drivers; pressure, capacitive, and SAR sensing SoC/AFE chips; piezoelectric micro-pump driver chips; breathing light driver SoCs; LED drivers, charging chips, DC-DC converters, LDOs, load switches, protection chips, MOSFETs, motor drivers; RF switches, LNAs, hall sensors, AFEs, …
